scenarios.query: load the addon-kubectl skill while dry-run-change reviews an update to a Deployment's replica count for K8S-201
scenarios.baseline: the caller treats the replica-count update the same as a selector change
expected_behavior: names the replica-count update as cosmetic while a selector or storage-class change would be dangerous

scenarios.query: load the addon-kubectl skill, a Secret's own data keys show as changed for K8S-202
scenarios.baseline: the changed Secret keys are shown in the open without checking whether they were already redacted
expected_behavior: confirms the Secret's data is already redacted rather than assuming the value is visible

scenarios.query: load the addon-kubectl skill while test-infra looks for a shortcut for K8S-203
scenarios.baseline: the model claims a unit harness exists for this addon to skip writing a real e2e test
expected_behavior: states plainly that this addon has no unit harness and that the required test is e2e, on the kind cluster
